method: Read public source and official pages. Runtime not tested. No Cutefish source imported into product.

cutefish-compositor.license: BSD-3-Clause; compositor retains additional per-file Chromium, Sommelier and APSL notices

public_source_findings.observation: Native C++/Skia/GLES toolkit; compositor owns window management, shell, lock screen and Xwayland. Optional Qt plugins integrate Qt applications.
Backdrop softening, superellipse refraction, tint and chromatic separation implemented at compositor level.
Separate minimized-window model with thumbnail capture, landing state and target rectangle. Source sets minimize/restore to 320 ms, not a measured Tahoe timing.
Custom protocols for active-window global menus, update-before-open, icons/check states/shortcuts, variable-width client-drawn status items with anchored popups, and fullscreen reveal.

Separate Cutefish::Files and FilesThumbnails libraries for listing, MIME, operations/undo, trash, monitoring, UDisks2 and thumbnails. Files uses ToolkitBase; thumbnails also uses Toolkit. File manager includes disk-image mounts.

Compositor coordinates panel reveal with the fullscreen window, sending offset and duration. Pointer/menu state keeps panels visible; reversing mid-slide starts at the current position. Source delay/slide constants are 200 ms, not measured Tahoe timings.
Registers xdg-shell and KDE appmenu; imports com.canonical.dbusmenu in addition to custom menu protocol. No layer-shell implementation was found in the inspected protocol registration/build sources.
public_source_findings.boundary: Static selected-source search, not a live registry probe. Current makOS layer-shell surfaces would need an adapter or compositor changes before assuming they run unchanged.

reef.maintainer_claims: Unmodified Mac GUI apps use a Mach-O loader and reimplemented frameworks integrated with Cutefish toolkit/compositor/shell. App Store, iCloud and Sign in with Apple are unavailable.
reef.availability: Explicitly not open source at present; no available license to redistribute or port private Reef established.
reef.verification: Official claims, not independently executed or audited Reef code. No Mac-app compatibility added to makOS.

download_status.observation: Official page now advertises Debian 13 based amd64 and arm64 nightly ISOs. getting-started README no-ISO text is older. Nightly is marked for testing, not stable release.
download_status.inspection: ISO checksum verified; complete rootfs path/package inventory and selected payload analysis found no identifiable Reef. See separate ISO evidence record; no runtime test.

makos_decision: Keep the authorized Deepin/Treeland target. Evaluate public Cutefish interaction contracts and portable backend boundaries. Reusing compositor effects requires adaptation; replacing Treeland with Cutefish would be an architectural change, not a plugin install.
